title: Guess (Izanami)
body:
Syntax: guess <number>

Description: If trapped in Izanami, guess the hidden number from 1 to 25. You may guess immediately after the illusion begins and only once in each 15-second loop thereafter. A correct guess breaks the loop and notifies the caster. A wrong guess inflicts 8-12% of your maximum Health (cannot reduce below 1 HP) and informs the caster of your mistake and the damage. Wait for the next loop before another attempt. This command has no effect outside Izanami.
